response.sql:
WITH project_funding AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    sp.domainregistry,
    sp.aream2,
    sp.volm3,
    sp.boxx,
    sp.boxy
  FROM projects p
  JOIN scanspatial sp ON p.arcregistry = sp.arcref
  WHERE sp.aream2 IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.volm3 IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.boxx IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.boxy IS NOT NULL
),
funding_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    fundflux,
    AVG((boxy - boxx) / NULLIF(boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff,
    SUM(aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio
  FROM project_funding
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
cross_source_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM funding_metrics
)
SELECT
  fm.fundflux,
  fm.avg_y_vs_x_diff,
  fm.area_to_volume_ratio,
  fm.area_to_volume_ratio - csa.avg_ratio AS above_average
FROM funding_metrics fm
CROSS JOIN cross_source_avg csa
WHERE fm.area_to_volume_ratio > csa.avg_ratio
ORDER BY fm.area_to_volume_ratio DESC;

assumptions.assumption: "Ignore missing values" refers to NULL values in required fields (aream2, volm3, boxx, boxy); records with any NULL in these fields are excluded.
Division by zero (boxx = 0 or volm3 = 0) is handled via NULLIF, treating the result as NULL, which aggregation functions skip.

alternatives.interpretation: Instead of NULLIF for division-by-zero handling, explicitly exclude records where boxx ≤ 0 or volm3 ≤ 0 via WHERE clause.
